spam PyPI package compromised via phishing.

Transitive: false
Impact Type: Infostealer, Credential theft

Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Similar to the 'exotel' incident during the same phishing campaign ("JuiceLedger"), the maintainer account for a PyPI package named 'spam' was compromised. Malicious versions (2.0.2, 4.0.2) were uploaded, designed to download and execute infostealer malware upon installation.

  • 4.0.2
